meta.title: Phorpi — E-export consultancy that takes your product to global markets
meta.description: Bring your product from Türkiye to global markets end-to-end — certification, company setup, trademark, accounting, logistics, ads.

ui.marquee_label: Marketplaces we manage and operate on

hero.title: We take your product to global markets.
hero.lede: From certification and company setup to trademark and ad management — end to end. We don't just talk about these processes; we run them on our own Amazon and Etsy operations.

services.title: Amazon End-to-End Management
services.short: Account opening, category approvals, listing optimization, A+ content, PPC management, inventory and FBA planning, account health monitoring.
services.excluded: Amazon ad budget, Amazon fees and FBA charges, and creative production costs are not included.

services.title: Certification and Product Compliance
services.short: Identifying and securing the certificates your product needs for the target country: CE, FDA, UKCA, FCC, REACH, ISO and product-specific tests.
services.excluded: Laboratory fees, official duties and authority application fees are not included.
services.duration: 4–16 weeks depending on product and country

services.title: Overseas Company Formation
services.short: US LLC, UK Ltd, Germany GmbH, UAE Free Zone. Tax ID, bank account guidance, registered agent, annual obligation calendar.
services.excluded: Government duties, notary and apostille costs, bank fees are not included.

services.price_note: $279 for two classes · +$110 per additional class
services.title: Trademark Registration
services.short: Trademark registration in Türkiye and target countries. Registration setup for Amazon Brand Registry is planned in parallel.
services.excluded: Office filing and opposition fees are not included.

services.price_note: Varies by country and filing intensity
services.title: Overseas E-Export Accounting
services.short: Booking of overseas sales revenue. US sales tax, EU VAT/OSS, UK VAT, target-country tax registrations and filings; monthly reconciliation.
process: Target-country tax structure and liability analysis
Local tax registrations and accounting partner setup
services.excluded: Tax payments, overseas accounting partner fees and platform tax withholdings are not included in the service price.

services.price_note: Per-shipment pricing · varies by volume and route
services.title: Product Shipping and Transit Warehousing
services.short: Shipping from Türkiye to target markets with transit warehousing. Product consolidation, customs preparation, forwarder coordination, and delivery to destination warehouse.
process: Intake and consolidation at transit warehouse
Delivery to destination warehouse or marketplace
services.excluded: Freight, customs duties, transit warehouse storage fees and destination warehouse intake fees are not included.

services.price_note: Varies by category and market depth
services.title: Private Label — Analysis Engagement
services.short: In-depth market analysis for the category you want to enter: demand and seasonality, competitor map, price bands, product-to-marketplace integration and differentiation opportunities.
process: Demand, search volume and seasonality data
services.excluded: Supplier sourcing, samples, production, packaging design and launch are out of scope — pursued as a separate project on request.

services.title: Marketplace Management
services.short: Etsy, eBay, Walmart, Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Noon, Otto, Allegro. Account opening, product entry, pricing strategy, multi-marketplace inventory sync.
services.excluded: Marketplace commissions, ad budgets and subscription fees are not included.

services.price_note: Base package options shared on request
services.title: Creative and Visual Production
services.short: Product photography and video, 3D render, listing images, A+/EBC design, brand and packaging design, ad creative.
services.excluded: Model, location, prop and licensed music/stock costs are not included.

services.price_note: Google, Meta, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn · ad budget billed separately
services.title: Performance Marketing
services.short: Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn ad management. Social media account management and content calendar, conversion tracking and reporting.
services.excluded: Ad budgets and third-party tool subscriptions are not included.

services.title: Government Incentives
services.short: Ministry of Trade e-export incentives, market entry documentation support, foreign trademark support, trade fair support, Turquality guidance.
services.excluded: Office fees and mandatory advisor/audit costs are not included.

reasons.title: We run our own operation
reasons.text: We manage our Amazon and Etsy accounts directly. Every process we describe has been tested with our own money and our own products.

reasons.title: One contact, one connected process
reasons.text: Certification, formation, trademark, accounting, logistics and ads under one plan and one owner — not four agencies and four calendars.

reasons.title: Predictable scope and cost
reasons.text: Line-item time and price in every proposal; third-party costs shown as separate lines. No surprise line items midway.

sss.title: Frequently asked
sss.subtitle: If you don't find your answer here, write to us directly.

faqs.a: We publish prices for services with a standard scope. Certification, company formation and logistics vary so much by product and country that we run an analysis first, then quote.
No. Official fees, laboratory costs, government duties, ad budgets and marketplace commissions are separate from the service price and shown as separate lines in the proposal.

faqs.q: Can I buy a single service?
faqs.a: Yes. Packages are common bundles; every service is also available on its own. We scope it together.
Market-entry setup typically 3–6 weeks. Items like certification and company formation range 2–16 weeks by country and product. Every proposal has line-item durations.

faqs.q: Is trademark registration required for Amazon Brand Registry?
faqs.a: Yes, Brand Registry requires a valid trademark registration or application number. We plan the registration alongside the Amazon process.

iletisim.title: Let's define the scope together.
iletisim.note: We respond to proposal requests within two business days. The first scope conversation is free.
